what: A small character hidden just outside the photo frame edge (where the frame clips it out of view) rises half its own height into the frame over .2s cubic-bezier(.455,.03,.515,.955) when you hover the card or link holding that frame, peeking out, and hides again in the same time when you let go. Each card uses a different edge (bottom·top·left) and a different character comes out

options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Clipping frame (child) — overflow hidden is applied. If absent, the user provides a clipping box
options.[data-fx-part=peek]: Hidden character (inside the frame) — the user places it outside the edge, like top:100%·bottom:100%·right:100%
options.data-key: On peek — bottom (default, −50% from below), top (50% from above), left (70% from the left), right (−70% from the right)
options.--fx-x·--fx-y: Peek distance (via style on peek), default 0 and −50% — original contact card −45% and −60%
options.look: touch-out: On touch screens (no hover) the character is always out — the original’s phone view more

from.where: index.html .sn-service__card (white service card: a character with eyes peeks out from the edge of the photo frame) — original .p-service__hoverIcon --01~06·.p-incContact__hoverIcon

shared.js .h-more (view more button — an orange blob character 90px hidden outside the bottom right of a 50px navy circle frame enters diagonally) — original .viewMoreParts svg transform translate(50%,50%) → translate(-8%,-2%) .5s
from.options: place peek at Frame left·top 45px (half its own size) and style="--fx-x: -58%; --fx-y: -52%; --fx-dur: .5s; --fx-ease: cubic-bezier(.045,.821,.559,.611)" · look: touch-out

note: A CSS-only part, so there is no fx.js. It does not appear on touch screens (the original also uses it only in the hover media query)
